author: Corridor Crew
description:
John Whitney is considered by many the father of animated motion graphics. Back in the 60's, he deviced a machine based on an analog 40's military anti-artilery predicting computer to create a very special type of slit-scan effect machine.

Can you imagine how he even came up with this?
title: He INVENTED motion graphics?!
